intro:
Damage buffs are best split and placed into various categories to easily digest and
contextualise how damage buffs work and interact with each other

In this section you can see the different categories

NOTE: most damage modifiers are multiplicative - meaning they are multiplied together

The order of the multiplication does not matter and you can stack as many damage modifiers as possible
Note: Melee-increasing damage modifiers are additive

categories.name: Global Debuffs
categories.desc:
An effect inflicted by us Guardians onto an enemy target
Combatants or other Guardians

Void Sandbox
Some Exotic Weapons & Armor

categories.rule: Cannot stack with other Global Debuffs; highest takes precedence
notes:
Note about "Extending Debuff Duration":

30% Debuffs from Felwinter's Helm, Fafnir, and Tractor Cannon can have their durations extended by most Weaken sources - this does not affect Tether's debuff (Tether functions differently)

For example: if Tractor Cannon's debuff is applied, then a Void Soul is sent out and does its Weaken before Tractor's debuff
expires it will refresh the duration until the Void Soul expires - this can be repeated indefinitely
Note: Gambit (normally) uses PvP values

categories.name: Weapon Surges
categories.desc: An effect applied directly onto a Guardian from the 'Armor Surge' system
categories.sources:
Armor Charge System
Exotic Armor
Misc Sources (Artifact)
categories.rule: Cannot stack with other Weapon Surges; highest takes precedence
notes:
Note about Surge "Stacking":

Mods, Exotics, and Artifact Surges all share the same system which means the highest same-Element Surge always takes priority.

However, Armor Surges still work and their timers tick independently from Surges triggered by Exotic Armor.

While same-Element Surges cannot be stacked, you can mix-and-match different-Element Surges with no issues.

Gambit Sandbox:

For the purposes of the Surge system, Gambit uses PvP sandbox values and durations for both Combatants and Guardians

For example: activating Foetracer on a Combatant in Gambit provides a 4x matching-Element for 6s for a 6% damage buff against both Combatants and Guardians
Note: Gambit uses PvP values

entries.name: Kinetic Surge Mod

variants.trigger:
Adds 1x Surge stack per Mod applied on your Armor
(Legs slot)

While having at least 1x Armor Charge active you gain a temporary damage buff matching your currently equipped Mod(s)

For example: 1x Armor Charge with 2x Kinetic Surge Mods provides
17% in PvE and 4.4% in PvP

entries.notes:
Duration is variable; the duration can be affected by the following:

Number of Armor Charges active
Each Armor Charge stack last 10s

ex: 30s at 3x Charges

Extended number of Armor Charges active
Charged Up Mod increases Armor Charge stacks to 4, 5, and 6 if multiple Mods equipped

ex: 60s at 6x Charges

If you are using Time Dilation Mod
Time Dilation Mod increases decay time of each Armor Charge stack if multiple Mods are equipped to: 15s, 18s, and 20s

ex: 60s at 3x Charges using 3x TD Mods
ex: 120s at 6x Charges using 3x TD Mods
entries.misc:

do NOT affect Golden Gun
(interactions fixed Jan 30 - Update 7.3.4)
